extDescription.message: Firefox MCP addon for Claude Code — browser automation via extension + native messaging

setupHostMissingText.message: Firefox cannot find the KitsuneMCP native host. Build KitsuneMCP and run its installer in your KitsuneMCP folder (a clone of the repository):

setupHostMissingNote.message: Then press Recheck. Flatpak Firefox: see the installation guide (re-running the installer alone does not help there).

setupHostErrorText.message: The native host is registered but did not work ($1). Re-running the installer fixes the usual cause, a Node.js that was upgraded or moved:

setupHostOutdatedTitle.message: Native host is out of date

setupHostOutdatedText.message: Browser tools still work, but your KitsuneMCP folder is older than this extension. Pull the latest version there, rebuild it and re-run the installer (it updates the native host):

setupDaemonDownText.message: The native host runs, but the KitsuneMCP server does not answer.

setupDaemonDownTextAt.message: The native host runs, but the KitsuneMCP server does not answer at $1.

setupNoSessionText.message: Firefox is ready. Either KitsuneMCP is not registered with Claude Code, or no Claude Code session is running. To register it:

setupNoSessionNote.message: After registering, restart Claude Code. A running session shows up here within about 30 seconds.

toastCopyFailed.message: Copy failed: select the command and copy it by hand

badgeHostOutdated.message: KitsuneMCP: native host is out of date

badgeApprovalPending.message: KitsuneMCP: $1 approval request(s) waiting for you

notifyApprovalDefault.message: Claude wants to perform an action

notifyApprovalProtected.message: $1 on $2 needs your approval. Click the KitsuneMCP toolbar button to approve or deny.

notifyApprovalQuestion.message: $1 — answer with the KitsuneMCP toolbar button.

notifyCaptchaMessage.message: Claude paused on a captcha and needs you to solve it.

bannerCaptchaTitle.message: 🧩 Please solve the captcha ($1), then it continues automatically.

bannerCaptchaDetail.message: KitsuneMCP paused and is waiting for you. Click Done if it does not continue on its own.

approvalProtectedNote.message: Approve only if you asked for this. It allows this one call and nothing else. $1 s left.

approvalMessageNote.message: Your answer goes back to Claude; it does not unlock protected sites. $1 s left.

toastApprovalGone.message: This request is no longer pending
